items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
To the 4th: Celtics 77, #Magic 74

Tristan da Silva (4 for 7 from 3) has 18 points, Anthony Black up to 16, Desmond Bane (4 for 7 from 3) with 14, and Franz Wagner with 8 points and 10 assists.

items.title: Sean Sweeney sat both Franz Wagner and Wendell Carter Jr. early in the third quarter. After a few minutes they both came back in, and played much better after getting back on the floor.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Sean Sweeney sat both Franz Wagner and Wendell Carter Jr. early in the third quarter. After a few minutes they both came back in, and played much better after getting back on the floor.

Good "get your heads right" break call from Sweeney.
